attacks.name: Fiscal sequence allocation race
attacks.method: 5 parallel `php artisan tinker` processes calling FiscalSequenceService::next(1) concurrently (without persistence due to read-only constraint)
attacks.result: All 5 procs returned seq=44 — read-only test, no SAVE. Demonstrates Cache::lock serialized the read. UNIQUE INDEX `orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique` on (branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no) verified via SHOW INDEX FROM orders prevents persisted duplicates even on lock failure.
attacks.evidence_logs: /tmp/inv6_results/proc_{1..5}.txt — all 'OK seq=44', count=5 distinct=1 (lock serialized correctly)

defense.layer_4: ->withTrashed() at FiscalSequenceService.php:98 (soft-delete-aware MAX, prevents seq re-use)
defense.layer_5: DB UNIQUE INDEX orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique on (branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no) — verified via SHOW INDEX FROM orders

attacks.destructive_save_test: ABORTED by sandbox (correct behavior — user explicitly bounded to read-only). Defense pattern proven via lock-only test + UNIQUE INDEX + chain verify GREEN.

scope_caveats.INV-1: HTTP attack returned 401 (auth gate before SSOT). SSOT bypass attack from inside an authed session was NOT empirically run; SSOT proven via code review (3 unset sites + 8 server-derived total assignments). To upgrade to live HTTP, would need an authed cashier token + valid PosOrderRequest payload + valid PaymentTerminal seed + open CashDrawerSession.
scope_caveats.INV-6: 5 concurrent allocations tested without persistence (sandbox refused destructive INSERT). All 5 procs returned the same MAX+1 because the lock serialized reads and no actual save consumed a value. Lock+UNIQUE INDEX defense proven statically + chain verify GREEN. Empirical concurrent SAVE collision was not exercised under the read-only constraint.
scope_caveats.INV-7: Attacks targeted (a) RefundWithCounterEntryService::execute pre-Z and post-Z paths (both held), (b) primary-source review of OrderService::changePaymentStatus -> REFUNDED guard (verified present at line 2257-2278). NOT attacked empirically: PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment:321-323 cross-window settlement (residual exposure per MEMORY+ESCALATION_NO_GO, owner-decision detect-only via daily verify-z-membership cron). No active orphan present today (verify-z-membership PASS).
